# Setup und Lernziele

## Laden der Programmbibliotheken

# Netzwerk einlesen

```{r setup und Netzwerk einlesen}

library(igraph)

el <- read.csv(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ninah113/SNA-Projekt_Trump-Truth-Social/refs/heads/main/Edges.csv",
  header = TRUE, sep = ",", stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

nl <- read.csv(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ninah113/SNA-Projekt_Trump-Truth-Social/refs/heads/main/Nodes.csv",
  header = TRUE, sep = ",", stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

t <- graph_from_data_frame(
  d = el,
  vertices = nl,
  directed = TRUE
)

t

```

# Visualisierung 

```{r Visualisierung Anne Will, fig.height=9, fig.width=12}

# Visualisierung

plot(t,
     asp=0,
     vertex.size=degree(aw)/2,
     main = "Trump Truth Social Netzwerk"
     )

```
